flipToBack.prose: Flip if opponent controls NO Bespin locations, AND you control Bespin: Cloud City (the site), AND (you control >= 2 Cloud City sites, OR (Lando or Lobot is on Cloud City [at any Cloud City site] AND you control >= 1 Cloud City site)). All checks with SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE.

children.req: control: owner controls the Bespin: Cloud City site
control: owner controls >=2 Cloud City sites
card-on-Cloud-City: Lando or Lobot on Cloud City (Filters.on_Cloud_City = locationAndCardsAtLocation(Filters.Cloud_City_site), i.e. at ANY Cloud City site)
control: owner controls >=1 Cloud City site

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if opponent controls Bespin system, OR opponent controls at least 3 locations among Cloud City sites and/or Bespin cloud sectors (combined count).

children.req: control: opponent controls the Bespin system
control-count: opponent controls >=3 locations matching (Cloud City site OR Bespin cloud sector)

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: CONTROL semantics on all location legs (opponent zero Bespin locations; owner controls Bespin: Cloud City site; owner controls 2 [or 1] Cloud City sites). No occupy, no 'with' actor filter on control legs.
Lando/Lobot leg: card-position semantics via Filters.on_Cloud_City (at any Cloud City site), NOT control and NOT restricted to the Bespin: Cloud City named site.
flipToFront: CONTROL semantics, disjunctive: opponent controls Bespin system, or a combined count of 3 across Cloud City sites and Bespin cloud sectors.
typedIdentities: Filters.Bespin_location (opponent zero-control constraint, front; drain limit both legs)
Filters.Bespin_Cloud_City (the named Cloud City site owner must control)
Filters.or(Filters.Lando, Filters.Lobot) (personas easing the site count)
Filters.or(Filters.site, Filters.cloud_sector) to Title.Bespin (front per-turn download)
Filters.and(CardSubtype.SYSTEM, Filters.title(Title.Bespin, true)) (blown-away out-of-play, both sides)

Back: Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.or(Filters.alien, Filters.cloud_car, Filters.and(Icon.INDEPENDENT, Filters.starship))); Filters.and(Filters.Bespin_location, Filters.controlsWith(playerId, self, Filters.alien))
setupAndPullRoutes: START OF GAME (front, required): deploy Bespin system: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.Bespin_system, true, false) [Card109_004.java:53-59]
START OF GAME (front, required): deploy one Cloud City battleground site: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.Cloud_City_battleground_site, true, false) [Card109_004.java:60-66]

FRONT, once per owner's deploy phase, cost 1 Force: deploy a site or cloud sector to Bespin from Reserve Deck; reshuffle: DeployCardToSystemFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.or(Filters.site, Filters.cloud_sector), Title.Bespin, true), GameTextActionId.QUIET_MINING_COLONY__DOWNLOAD_SITE_OR_CLOUD_SECTOR [Card109_004.java:71-93]

BACK, once per owner's deploy phase (free): deploy one docking bay from Reserve Deck; reshuffle: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.docking_bay, true), GameTextActionId.INDEPENDENT_OPERATION__DOWNLOAD_DOCKING_BAY [Card109_004_BACK.java:66-84]

BACK: at each Bespin location you control with an alien, your Force drains may not be modified or canceled by opponent: ForceDrainsMayNotBeModifiedModifier + ForceDrainsMayNotBeCanceledModifier on Filters.and(Filters.Bespin_location, Filters.controlsWith(playerId, self, Filters.alien)) [Card109_004_BACK.java:59-60]
BACK: your [Independent] starships deploy -1: DeployCostModifier(self, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Icon.INDEPENDENT, Filters.starship), -1) [Card109_004_BACK.java:61]
